messages:
noah: Quick sync  Proposal: support a safe 'pin-transfer' flow when we upgrade catalog models (e.g., v1 -> v1.1) so existing pinned tenants can opt-in with compatibility checks.

anya: Nice. Major risk is silent behavioral drift during transfer. What checks do you have in mind?

noah: Minimal flow: 1) artifact digest compare (weights + tokenizer), 2) golden-prompt diff on 100 canonical prompts, 3) seed-stability (N=20) variance check, 4) post-transfer shadow-compare for 24h. If any gate fails, auto-revert.

pradeep: Ops: must ensure tokenization parity. If tokenization changes, fallback isn't safe. Also we need a traffic policy: transfer should be opt-in per-tenant with a rollback hook that completes within 30 minutes.

zoe: Product question: do we allow automatic transfer for low-risk semantic-only patches (hotfixes) or require explicit customer acceptance?

noah: Suggestion: two tiers: auto-transfer for 'compatibility patches' (minor version bumps with identical tokenizer hash and <0.5pt median delta on golden set) and manual opt-in for other upgrades.

anya: For audits, we need to log: previous artifact digest, post-transfer digest, metrics snapshot, and customer acceptance timestamp. Retain 180 days.

infra-bot: infra: recorded policy -> pin_transfer_flow=enabled, audit_retention=180d, auto_transfer_threshold=0.5pt

pradeep: Implementation notes: snapshot + golden diff tooling ~4 biz days; shadow-compare infra reuse ~3 days; tokenization-hash check quick. Rollback automation to hit 30m SLA ~5 days.

zoe: From GTM: communicate transfer policy in catalog entries: "model upgrades may be auto-transferred if compatibility gates pass; tenants may opt-out". Need FAQ blurb.

noah: Decision: build pin-transfer feature with two tiers (auto-transfer for low-risk patches + manual opt-in otherwise). Preconditions: tokenization hash equality and golden-set median delta <0.5pt for auto-transfer. Action items: pradeep->prototype snapshot+diff (4d), anya->write comms + FAQ (2d), zoe->update catalog policy copy.

pradeep: Starting spike today and will post perf impact estimates.

noah: Thanks all. We'll track in the pin-transfer epic and circle back on infra estimates. :thumbsup:
